Ryuichi was a major rapist that treated his victims as toys, until a sudden change happens to him after he graduated from college. Several years later, he starts to work at a clinic and there recognizes one of his previous victims, Ayaka the wife of his boss. item.title: Intruder
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: material
  • 発売日: 2012-06-22
  • スコア: 6.94/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: イントルーダー
  • 英語名: Intruder

あらすじ

The protagonist, Toono Kenji, has a unique appearance that made his life difficult, causing him to become an outcast and struggle to find work. After getting into trouble with the yakuza, he ends up hiding in a remote boarding house with young women, where he is mistaken for a teenage boy and decides to pretend to be one. However, he soon realizes that he has fallen into a trap without knowing it.
